load.title: Electricity Load
load.limitation: Coverage requires every source component; no missing target values are imputed.

wind.title: Wind Generation
wind.limitation: Coverage requires every source component; no missing target values are imputed.
wind.importance_method: Validation permutation MAE increase: 1000 rows, 3 repeats, seed 42; positive increases normalized.

solar.title: Solar Generation
solar.limitation: Coverage requires every source component; no missing target values are imputed.
solar.importance_method: Validation permutation MAE increase: 1000 rows, 3 repeats, seed 42; positive increases normalized.

long_range.use_when: First prediction more than one day after source data, or requested horizon longer than one day.
long_range.evaluation: Direct calendar predictions over the complete held-out test window, with calibration fixed before that window. Model selected on validation MAE.
long_range.limitation: Calendar-average Solar pattern without future weather. Scale uses preceding 28 observed days; output is bounded by maximum observed Solar at source cutoff. Future capacity growth is not extrapolated.

evaluation: One-step walk-forward with observed prior values; 70/15/15 chronological per target.
selection: Lowest validation MAE. Test scores never choose the deployed model.

quality_exclusions.action: Excluded; affected feature windows also excluded; no future interpolation.
